title: Moon Hub
features:
🚀 MAIN AUTOMATION (AUTO FARM)
• Auto Farm: Multi-enemy selection, smart targeting, and kill counting.
• Auto Quest: Automatically accepts and completes quests with map support (Shinobi Village, Desert Kings, Hunters Domain, Shinobi Village, and Namek).
• Auto Dungeon: Automated dungeon farming with lightning-fast door detection and room navigation.
• Auto Trial: Auto-joins trials (including Christmas Trial), synchronizes farm status, and restores position after exit.
• %HP Swap System: Smart team swapping based on enemy HP percentage to optimize kills.

🎲 ROLLING & GACHA SYSTEMS
• Auto Roll Eggs: High-speed egg rolling.
• Hide Egg Animation: Skip roll animations for maximum speed.
• Auto Roll Talents: Continuously rolls talents until the desired result is achieved.
• Auto Roll Trait: Automatically rolls traits.

🛠️ UTILITY & MISC FEATURES
• Auto Collect Drops: Magnetically pulls all drops and lootboxes to the player.
• Auto Redeem: Automatically claims Codes, Daily Rewards, Achievements, and Timer rewards.
• Webhook System: Sends Discord notifications for pet drops and rare items.
• Hide Notifications: Toggle to hide all in-game script notifications.
• Change Display Name: Client-side tool to modify your overhead player name.
• Inf Candy: Special feature for infinite candy (Christmas Update).

⚡ PERFORMANCE & MOVEMENT
• Anti-Lag (VFX Disabler): Disables particles, lights, and shadows for max FPS.
• Anti-AFK System: Multi-method bypass for Roblox and in-game idle timers.
• Movement Suite: Includes Fly System, Infinite Jump, and adjustable HipHeight.
• Extreme Optimization: Smart Caching and low memory footprint for PC and Mobile.
